calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT sale_date FROM fact_sales_line WHERE channel_code = 'WB'
)
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  period_start_date,
  period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  fiscal_year,
  fiscal_period,
  fully_loaded
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT channel_code
FROM fact_sales_line
ORDER BY channel_code

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS null_channel_records,
  SUM(net_amount) AS null_channel_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code IS NULL
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount), 2) AS net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE f.channel_code = 'WB'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
